_comment: Bubblewrap TWA config, prepared ahead of production deployment (no live HTTPS domain yet — see android/README.md). Values here mirror frontend/vite.config.ts's VitePWA manifest block so the two never drift apart. DOMAIN_PLACEHOLDER must be replaced with the real production host everywhere it appears before building — or better, once the domain is live, re-run `bubblewrap init --manifest=https://<domain>/manifest.webmanifest` to regenerate this file fresh (it will re-validate against the real manifest and re-download the real icons) and diff it against this one rather than hand-editing.
